The solid is a **right cylinder**. 

Notice the following:

- The solid has two parallel circular bases. So, it's a cylinder.

- The axis that passes through the centers of the circles is perpendicular to the bases. So, it's right.
html:
The solid is a right cylinder.

Notice the following:

  • The solid has two parallel circular bases. So, it's a cylinder.

  • The axis that passes through the centers of the circles is perpendicular to the bases. So, it's right.
